name: Leena AI
summary: Enterprise HR and IT service-desk platform whose 'AI Colleague' answers employee questions from a company knowledge base. For agents it ships a first-party MCP server (and an A2A 1.0 server) that exposes the whole Colleague as one conversational sub-agent: exactly three tools (send_message, request_details, cancel), and send_message takes a natural-language instruction and returns a grounded answer with authenticated source links. OAuth 2.0 only, no API-key mode and no anonymous access; the MCP endpoint URL is per-tenant.

payments.notes: leena.ai/pricing publishes no figure and routes to sales ('Talk to a specialist'); the plan and billing terms are not stated on the surfaces read here, so humanBilling is unknown. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: OAuth 2.0 only, bearer token: the docs state 'There is no API-key mode and no anonymous access.' Three grants (authorization_code, refresh_token, jwt-bearer/ID-JAG). The MCP URL is per-tenant (ends in /mcp/) from the dashboard, so there is no single public endpoint and it was not probed here.

jobs.summary: send_message passes an employee's question to Leena's AI Colleague, returning a knowledge-base-grounded answer with authenticated source links; input_required can route a follow-up. Orchestrator-routed behind generic tools, no named policy tool. Accuracy, deflection, escalation: no vendor figure.
